source.author: verg
source.text: Sola India nigrum fert ebenum, solis est turea virga Sabaeis.
source.text_original: Sola India nigrum / fert ebenum, solis est turea virga Sabaeis.
source.text_english: India alone produces black ebony; the Sabaeans alone have the frankincense branch.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Saba a quo Sabaei, de quibus Virgilius: Solis est thurea virga Sabaeis.
reuse.text_original: Saba a quo Sabaei, de quibus Virgilius: Solis est thurea virga Sabaeis.
reuse.text_english: Sheba, from whom the Sabaeans are named, about whom Virgil says: “The incense-bearing branch belongs to the Sabaeans of the sun.”
